ordering: W ascending; profile constant then piecewise; gap zero then 1/20
calendar: begin=snapshot=k*P+w*P/W; correction if ERR=1 and release=begin+D; only actions<=T
service: E: latch ERR and correctly decoded original image; write that full image at release iff latched ERR=1, otherwise preserve memory
events: NHPP on array; each event independently chooses one word and one of all38 bits uniformly; XOR inversion
initial: all words clean, no pending write; synthetic specified state, no physical preparation claim

mc.seed_rule: SeedSequence([seed_base,case_index]) with PCG64; zero-based declared ordering
mc.seed_selection: fixed before calculating any Q or MC counts

exact.arithmetic: Fraction positive-series bounds and outward rounding at every propagation step

main_bounds.L: T45 section2 (1)-(2), appendix A.1; no-service cells
main_bounds.V: (n-1)/(2n) * sum word exposure squared over virtual begin cells
main_bounds.X_E: (n-1)/n * sum previous-begin-to-begin exposure times begin-to-release exposure, clipped at0,T
main_bounds.U_E: min(1,V+X_E); T110 section3 pair witness / appendix A.2-A.3, fixed schedule

model_zero_terms.reason: clean initial state, singleton parents, ideal controller/service; specified synthetic assumptions
